process_area.title: Election-Period Compliance, Political Contributions & Lobbying Controls

value_stream.name: Corporate Political Engagement, Election Compliance & Public Affairs Governance

fields.Participants: Legal (links to VS-100), Compliance (links to VS-119), Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Marketing (links to VS-14), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Corporate Communications (links to VS-14.3), regional teams

workflows.name: Election-Period Compliance Protocol (Omnibus Election Code, RA 9006, COMELEC)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-communication of "communicate restrictions across all entities/stores/regions" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "print limits, blackout periods, and the risk that BuildRight promotions/ads…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document the cycle for disclosure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: protocol and pre-publication review; operational: enterprise-wide communication
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inadvertent-violation risk**: Marketing/activity construed as electioneering; mitigated by protocol and pre-publication review
- **Inconsistent-application risk**: Some stores/regions unaware; mitigated by enterprise-wide communication
System Touchpoints: - Legal (links to VS-100); marketing/comms (links to VS-14/VS-14.3); store ops (links to VS-07); ethics (links to VS-119); records (links to VS-88); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: VP Legal activate the election-period compliance protocol on COMELEC election-period declaration: communicate restrictions across all entities/stores/regions (no corporate contributions, no partisan activity, election-period advertising rules, no use of company resources for partisanship), and align Marketing/Comms/Store-Ops to the restrictions

Legal/Marketing implement election-period advertising/marketing restrictions (COMELEC rules on election propaganda, airtime/print limits, blackout periods, and the risk that BuildRight promotions/ads could be construed as indirect candidate/party support), with pre-publication review of sensitive campaigns
Legal/Compliance monitor compliance during the cycle, manage incidents (links to VS-119), and document the cycle for disclosure (links to W4032) and lessons (links to W4040)

fields.Participants: Legal, Finance (links to VS-17.4), Compliance (links to VS-119), ABC (links to VS-86), Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), CEO, Board
fields.Trigger: Contribution request; spend decision; election cycle

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Legal/Compliance review flagged spend" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "record and disclose any permitted political-adjacent spend" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-627 (ensure controlled execution — Election-Period Compliance, Political Contributions & Lobbying Controls (PA-132.2).)
- operational: prohibition, screening, and Board authority; operational: nexus review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Criminal-liability risk**: Prohibited contribution exposing officers; mitigated by prohibition, screening, and Board authority
- **Indirect-support risk**: Spend functioning as indirect contribution; mitigated by nexus review
System Touchpoints: - Finance (links to VS-17.4); ABC (links to VS-86); ethics (links to VS-119); records (links to VS-88); governance (links to VS-36); disclosure (links to W4032)

steps.activity: Legal/Finance maintain the campaign-finance/contribution control: the prohibition on direct/indirect corporate contributions to candidates, parties, and election campaigns under the Omnibus Election Code Art. XI §95 (incl. the §95(3) government-contractor/supplier prohibition relevant to BuildRight's B2G business) and RA 7166 campaign-finance rules, with RA 9006 governing propaganda/airtime limits (with criminal liability for officers/agents); the screening of any spend that could be indirect support; and Board authority for any political-adjacent spend

Legal/Compliance review flagged spend (sponsorships, donations, in-kind, candidate-linked events/charities, advertising near elections) for electoral nexus, apply ABC (links to VS-86) and anti-graft (links to W4037) controls, and approve or decline with documented rationale
Finance/Legal record and disclose any permitted political-adjacent spend (links to W4032) and report to the Board Audit Committee (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Legal, Marketing (links to VS-14.1/VS-14.2), Corporate Communications (links to VS-14.3), Retail Media (links to VS-48), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Compliance
fields.Trigger: Election period; marketing campaign; sensitive context

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review of election-period campaigns, ensure no candidate/party…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document for disclosure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-627 (ensure controlled execution — Election-Period Compliance, Political Contributions & Lobbying Controls (PA-132.2).)
- operational: pre-publication review and content rules; operational: content policy and takedown
Pain Points / Risks: - **Indirect-electioneering risk**: Ads construed as candidate support; mitigated by pre-publication review and content rules
- **Retail-media-misuse risk**: 3P political content on BuildRight channels; mitigated by content policy and takedown
System Touchpoints: - Marketing/comms (links to VS-14/VS-14.3); retail media (links to VS-48); store ops (links to VS-07); legal (links to VS-100); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Legal/Marketing map election-period restrictions on BuildRight advertising and promotions: COMELEC rules on election propaganda and blackout periods, the risk that BuildRight ads (featuring officials, timed near events, or near polling places) constitute indirect electioneering, and restrictions on political advertising on BuildRight's media channels/retail-media network

Legal/Marketing implement pre-publication review of election-period campaigns, ensure no candidate/party imagery/endorsement, manage retail-media and in-store signage to exclude political content, and apply blackout-period rules
Legal/Marketing monitor compliance, manage any takedowns/corrections, and document for disclosure (links to W4032) and lessons

fields.Participants: Legal, Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Corporate Communications (links to VS-14.3), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Compliance (links to VS-119)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Legal/Govt-Affairs maintain the candidate-engagement/endorsement governance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report to the Board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-627 (ensure controlled execution — Election-Period Compliance, Political Contributions & Lobbying Controls (PA-132.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Implied-endorsement risk**: Candidate visit/photo construed as endorsement; mitigated by neutral management
- **Campaign-on-premises risk**: Store/event used for campaign activity; mitigated by restrictions
System Touchpoints: - Govt affairs (links to VS-104); comms (links to VS-14.3); store ops (links to VS-07); legal (links to VS-100); records (links to VS-88); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Legal/Govt-Affairs maintain the candidate-engagement/endorsement governance: BuildRight does not endorse candidates/parties; candidate/official visits to stores/events are managed neutrally (no implied endorsement, no campaign activity, no use for partisan purposes); and any engagement is documented

Legal/Comms manage any candidate/official visit, photo, or event to preserve non-partisanship, avoid appearance of endorsement, and comply with election-period restrictions (links to W4033) and anti-graft (links to W4037)
Legal/Comms manage any inadvertent endorsement appearance (takedown, clarification), document, and report to the Board (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Legal, Compliance (links to VS-119/VS-86), Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), B2G Sales (links to VS-46), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), regional teams
fields.Trigger: Interaction with government official/employee; gift/hospitality; procurement context

workflows.name: Government Official, Employee & Procurement Interaction (Anti-Graft) Controls

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documentation of official interactions, and conduct standards for B2G sales" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review and approve any hospitality/gift/meals involving public officials" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "log interactions, escalate concerns via speak-up" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-627 (ensure controlled execution — Election-Period Compliance, Political Contributions & Lobbying Controls (PA-132.2).)
- operational: prohibition and review; operational: controls and documentation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Anti-graft-violation risk**: Gifts/favors to officials; mitigated by prohibition and review
- **Procurement-impropriety risk**: Bid-process interactions; mitigated by controls and documentation
System Touchpoints: - ABC (links to VS-86); ethics (links to VS-119); B2G (links to VS-46); procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34); govt affairs (links to VS-104); records (links to VS-88); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Legal/Compliance maintain the government-official interaction and anti-graft controls under RA 3019 (Anti-Graft) and RA 6713 (Code of Conduct for Public Officials): prohibitions on gifts/favors/hospitality to public officials (overlapping with ABC links to VS-86), documentation of official interactions, and conduct standards for B2G sales (links to VS-46) and govt-affairs staff (links to VS-104)

Legal/Compliance review and approve any hospitality/gift/meals involving public officials (generally prohibited, with narrow exceptions), manage procurement interactions to avoid bid-process impropriety (links to VS-46/VS-03), and ensure no facilitation payments
Legal/Compliance log interactions, escalate concerns via speak-up (links to VS-119), and report to the Board Audit Committee (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Legal, HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), Compliance (links to VS-119), affected business unit, Govt Affairs (links to VS-104)
fields.Trigger: Hiring of former government official/employee; staff move to government; confidential info

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review on hiring former government officials/employees" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Legal/HR screen candidates with government background for conflicts" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-627 (ensure controlled execution — Election-Period Compliance, Political Contributions & Lobbying Controls (PA-132.2).)
- operational: screening and cooling-off; operational: controls and training
Pain Points / Risks: - **Conflict-of-hire risk**: Hiring an official with procurement conflict; mitigated by screening and cooling-off
- **Confidential-info-misuse risk**: Improper use of official information; mitigated by controls and training
System Touchpoints: - HR (links to VS-19/VS-103); ethics/COI (links to VS-119); ABC (links to VS-86); legal (links to VS-100); records (links to VS-88); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Legal/HR maintain revolving-door/post-employment controls: restrictions and review on hiring former government officials/employees (anti-graft "cooling-off" and procurement-conflict considerations under RA 3019/RA 9184), and rules for staff leaving BuildRight for government roles (no misuse of confidential info, post-employment restrictions)
Legal/HR screen candidates with government background for conflicts (links to VS-119 conflict-of-interest and VS-86), manage any cooling-off/functional restrictions, and document decisions

Legal/Compliance manage confidential-information controls around government interactions (no improper use/disclosure of official information, no trading on MNPI), and report to governance (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Legal, Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), Compliance (links to VS-119), Corporate Communications (links to VS-14.3)
fields.Trigger: Advocacy campaign; employee-engagement activity; stakeholder mobilization

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-issue of "Legal/Govt-Affairs govern any grassroots/issue-advocacy activity" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "log the activity, manage incidents" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-627 (ensure controlled execution — Election-Period Compliance, Political Contributions & Lobbying Controls (PA-132.2).)
- operational: scope and restrictions; operational: voluntariness (links to W4030)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Partisanship-creep risk**: Issue advocacy sliding into candidate support; mitigated by scope and restrictions
- **Coercion risk**: Pressured employee participation; mitigated by voluntariness (links to W4030)
System Touchpoints: - Govt affairs (links to VS-104); HR (links to VS-19/VS-103); ethics (links to VS-119); comms (links to VS-14.3); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Legal/Govt-Affairs govern any grassroots/issue-advocacy activity (links to VS-104): scope (non-partisan policy issues only, not candidate/party), voluntary employee participation, no coercion (links to W4030), no company-resource use for partisanship, and disclosure (links to W4028/W4032)

Legal/Comms execute any advocacy communications (distinct from electioneering) with truthfulness, transparency, and election-period restrictions (links to W4033), ensuring no coordination with candidates/parties
Legal/Compliance monitor, log the activity, manage incidents (links to VS-119), and report (links to W4032)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Legal, Insights (links to VS-44), Strategy (links to VS-33), Compliance, external monitoring services
fields.Trigger: Continuous monitoring; election cycle; regulatory development

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitoring of legislation/regulation, election calendars and outcomes,…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-issue of "issue early warnings/briefs to leadership and affected units" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "Govt Affairs feed intelligence into strategy" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-627 (ensure controlled execution — Election-Period Compliance, Political Contributions & Lobbying Controls (PA-132.2).)
- operational: continuous monitoring and early-warning briefs; operational: impact assessment and prioritization
Pain Points / Risks: - **Late-warning risk**: Political/regulatory change detected too late; mitigated by continuous monitoring and early-warning briefs
- **Noise risk**: Intelligence not actionable; mitigated by impact assessment and prioritization
System Touchpoints: - Govt affairs (links to VS-104); insights (links to VS-44); strategy (links to VS-33); LGU (links to VS-76); B2G (links to VS-46); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs/Insights maintain the political-intelligence and early-warning system: monitoring of legislation/regulation, election calendars and outcomes, political risk by region/LGU, enforcement trends (anti-graft, election-law, ABC), and stakeholder/NGO/media signals

Govt Affairs/Legal assess exposure and impact on BuildRight (operations, B2G links to VS-46, supply chain links to VS-02, multi-LGU links to VS-76), and issue early warnings/briefs to leadership and affected units
Govt Affairs feed intelligence into strategy (links to VS-33), engagement planning (links to VS-104), risk assessment (W4026), and Board reporting (links to VS-36/W4048)
